description: Two four-step sequencers, each advancing one step on a rising edge at its own clock input and putting out the voltage set for the step it has reached

params.text: Sets the voltage channel a puts out on its first step, 0V to 5V
Sets the voltage channel a puts out on its second step, 0V to 5V
Sets the voltage channel a puts out on its third step, 0V to 5V
Sets the voltage channel a puts out on its fourth step, 0V to 5V
Sets the voltage channel b puts out on its first step, 0V to 5V
Sets the voltage channel b puts out on its second step, 0V to 5V
Sets the voltage channel b puts out on its third step, 0V to 5V
Sets the voltage channel b puts out on its fourth step, 0V to 5V

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V advances channel a by one step, wrapping from the fourth step back to the first
A rising edge past 1V advances channel b by one step, wrapping from the fourth step back to the first

outputs.text: The voltage of the channel a step the sequencer has reached, 0V to 5V
The voltage of the channel b step the sequencer has reached, 0V to 5V

notes: a channel does nothing until a clock is patched to its own input: the two channels have separate clocks and neither is normalled to the other
there is no reset input and no run control; a channel starts from its first step when the patch is loaded and is only moved on by its clock
nothing on the panel is lettered; the artwork carries the module name and no control labels at all

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
